name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
summary: Warcaller Gorlach calls you to the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity. Seek out High Executor Derrington at his base camp.

sections.title: The Bulwark
sections.body: High Executor Derrington holds a forward post along the Plaguelands border. You are asked to report to him there, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

faq.answer: High Executor Derrington's base camp is at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.
You are asked to seek out High Executor Derrington.
The Bulwark is east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.
